name: syndex
description: Worker serving the Synthesizer data API and the Syndex portal.

scripts.build: mkdir -p public/syndex/static && tailwindcss --input src/portal/app.css --output public/syndex/static/app.css --minify && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js public/syndex/static/htmx.min.js && cp src/portal/static/* public/syndex/static/ && npm run docs
scripts.docs: uv run --extra docs sphinx-build -q -d docs/build/doctrees docs/source public/syndex/docs
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply synthesizer-database --local && wrangler dev
scripts.test: node tests/worker_routes.mjs && node tests/portal_routes.mjs && node tests/edge_cache.mjs
